_comment: Named presets for bulk downloads. `verified: false` means the channelUrl is a best guess — the CLI shows you the resolved channel name and video count and waits for confirmation before downloading anything. Once a channel is confirmed, set verified to true to skip the prompt.

xander.label: Xander Budnick
xander.notes: 4K30 source for clipping. YouTube serves 2160p as VP9/AV1 only — there is no H.264 above 1080p — so preferH264 is off.

blair.label: Blair Conklin
blair.notes: 1080p60 H.264 — the most edit-friendly combination for CapCut/Premiere and the Skid Kids shorts pipeline.
